name: EZ Bar Close-Grip Curl
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and hold an EZ bar in front of your thighs using an underhand grip on the narrow inner angles.
Tuck your elbows snugly against your sides and brace your core.
Curl the bar upward toward your chest while keeping your upper arms stationary.
Squeeze your biceps briefly at the top, then lower the EZ bar slowly back to full arm extension.
tips: Avoid leaning back or swinging your hips to start the curl.
Keep your wrists aligned comfortably with the angled grip throughout the movement.
